textRuns.value: Fitted on fire episodes above 500 ha (EFFIS, 2016 to 2025; fires within 3 days merged), EU27 countries with enough episodes only; levels stop at twice the observed period. Pick Portugal: its shape falls below 1 at 1 000 ha. Click a country on the map or a table row to draw its curves. Maximum likelihood, year-block bootstrap for 95 % intervals; levels in episodes, observed level read from the record. Not a forecast. Every table carries its MLflow run.
